highlights.reason_zh: 能力、价格、上下文与安全边界同时改变 coding agent 的模型选择。
highlights.reason_en: Capability, price, context and safety boundaries change coding-agent model selection together.

highlights.reason_zh: Copilot 获得新的低成本 coding model，但内部评测与促销价需要真实仓库复测。
highlights.reason_en: Copilot gains a lower-cost coding model, but internal evaluation and promotional pricing need repository-level replication.

highlights.reason_zh: 远程算力访问可能进入出口许可范围，但规则日期尚待《联邦公报》确认。
highlights.reason_en: Remote compute access may enter export licensing, but rule dates await Federal Register confirmation.

highlights.reason_zh: 自然实验提醒团队不能只用 coding benchmark 代理真实开发产出。
highlights.reason_en: A natural experiment shows teams should not use coding benchmarks as the sole proxy for real development output.

highlights.reason_zh: 更早的一手来源把 Agent Substrate 从实验性捐赠纠正为已有 GKE GA 入口。
highlights.reason_en: Earlier primary evidence corrects Agent Substrate from an experimental donation to an existing GKE GA path.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 36/36 成功，并主动覆盖模型、工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、非英语材料与重大综合新闻。部分页面只有日期；厂商性能和规模数据尚待独立验证；无重大综合新闻破例入选。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded, with active coverage of models, tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, non-English material and exceptional general news. Some pages exposed dates only; vendor performance and scale claims await independent validation; no exceptional general-news item was included.
